biotools.name: CellSium

metadata.abstract: To train deep learning-based segmentation models, large ground truth datasets are needed. To address this need in microfluidic live-cell imaging, we present CellSium, a flexibly configurable cell simulator built to synthesize realistic image sequences of bacterial microcolonies growing in monolayers. We illustrate that the simulated images are suitable for training neural networks. Synthetic time-lapse videos with and without fluorescence, using programmable cell growth models, and simulation-ready 3D colony geometries for computational fluid dynamics are also supported.
metadata.title: CellSium: Versatile cell simulator for microcolony ground truth generation
